dct_description_sm: A Future Land Use designation can encompass a range of different zones. Zoning designations, contained within the City’s Zoning Bylaw, define permitted uses and regulations regarding density, massing, setbacks and form. Development Permit Area Guidelines, where they exist, provide a further level of design or environmental direction for development.
